Package com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx

package com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx
The real sandbox adapters, which drive Docker Sandboxes through the sbx command line. Used when harness.sandbox.mode=sbx.
  • SbxSandboxAgent runs a turn: it finds or creates the session's sandbox, copies attached files in, runs the agent headless, and turns its output into steps and a reply.
  • SbxSandboxTransfer moves a session between local and cloud with sbx move.
  • SbxCli builds every sbx command in one place, and CommandRunner is the seam tests replace so no real sbx is needed.
  • SandboxRegistry remembers which sandbox backs which session and how sandboxes are named.
